description: This is a shell script that sets up and tests git commit-graph features, including commit graph creation, verification, and handling of various edge cases and corruptions.

methods.name: graph_read_expect
methods.description: Function to verify the expected state of the commit-graph by reading it and comparing against expected output.

methods.name: verify_chain_files_exist
methods.description: Function to confirm that all commit-graph chain files referenced exist in the specified directory.

methods.name: corrupt_file
methods.description: Utility to modify a file at a specific position with optional data to simulate corruption.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk_file
methods.description: Utility to modify a specific chunk within a graph file to test chunk validation.
